full_prompt_en: The image is a square, finely lined graphic-novel illustration of an older man with a cane walking among sweeping blue-green structural curves. A narrow white border frames the image. The background is an interlocked arrangement of large blue-gray ribs, dark teal recesses, pale curved bands, and olive-green planes, suggesting a vast engineered interior without one simple vanishing point. Curves sweep from the upper left across the top and descend toward the lower right, while fine parallel lines describe their surfaces. The man stands left of center, seen in profile facing right and cropped near the lower edge. He wears a mustard-brown flat cap, matching long coat, rust-colored vest, dark trousers, and gloves. His face is weathered and angled downward, with a white mustache and short beard that catch the pale light. A thin dark cane descends from his right hand to the bottom edge, giving the forward-leaning figure a clear support point. His other hand remains near the coat pocket, and the coat hem moves slightly behind his stride. Around him, broad pale gray strips cross the lower half like pathways or elevated edges, layered over muted green panels and deeper blue channels. The right side opens into a lighter yellow-green cluster of curved shapes, contrasting with the dense navy upper left. Light seems to enter from the upper right, whitening some of the curved edges and the man's beard while leaving the folded dark ribs in cool shadow. The surface is drawn with delicate hatch marks and textured color washes; solid contour lines sharpen the figure and major structural boundaries. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, so the man appears small beside the oversized looping forms. The overall composition places a warm ochre human silhouette within a cool, intricate system of arcs and diagonals, giving the scene a thoughtful, exploratory mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、线条精细的图像小说插画，一位年长男子拄着手杖行走在扫过画面的蓝绿色结构曲线之间。窄白边围住图像。背景由巨大的蓝灰肋线、深青内凹处、浅色弯带和橄榄绿平面咬合而成，让人想到庞大的工程化室内，却没有单一简单消失点。曲线从左上扫过顶部，再降向右下，细平行线描出表面。男子站在中央偏左，以朝右的侧身出现，在下边附近被裁切。他戴芥末棕色鸭舌帽，穿同色长外套、锈色马甲、深裤和手套。面孔风霜感明显并向下倾，白色小胡子和短须承接浅光。一根细暗手杖从右手垂到底边，为前倾的身体提供清楚支撑点。另一只手靠近衣袋，外套下摆在步子后略微飘动。周围宽阔浅灰条带像通道或高架边缘一样横穿下半部，叠在低饱和绿平面与更深蓝色槽状区域上。右侧展开较亮的黄绿色曲线团块，对照密集的海军蓝左上方。光似从右上进入，提白部分弯曲边缘和男子胡须，让折叠的暗肋线保留冷影。表面以细密排线与有纹理的色洗绘成，实线轮廓使人物和主要结构边界锐利。视点略高，使男子在过大的循环形体旁显得很小。整体构图把暖赭人形放进冷色、繁复的弧线和斜线系统中，形成沉思而探索性的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Graphic-novel illustration joins precise dark contour and fine hatching to muted color washes. Deep teal and blue-gray occupy large interlocked areas; pale mint, olive, and a single warm ochre accent guide the eye through them. Broad arcs and diagonals sweep across a shallow yet layered space, with smaller parallel lines making their surfaces feel engineered and tactile. Hard outlines define the principal forms, while washed color and occasional grain soften the interiors of those forms. Selective light from an upper side catches pale edges and leaves deep cool recesses between overlapping bands. A compact warm focal silhouette is dwarfed by the surrounding curved structure, establishing scale through contrast. The overall effect is intricate, cool, and quietly dramatic, with disciplined linework carrying the spatial complexity.
style_prompt_zh: 图像小说插画把精确深色轮廓和细排线接到低饱和色洗上。深青与蓝灰占据咬合的大面积区域，浅薄荷绿、橄榄色与一处暖赭强调引导视线穿过它们。宽阔弧线与斜线扫过浅却层叠的空间，更小的平行线让表面带工程感与触感。坚硬轮廓定义主要形体，色洗和偶尔颗粒柔化形体内部。来自上侧的选择性光击中浅色边缘，在互相遮挡的色带间留下深冷内凹处。紧凑暖色焦点剪影被周围弯曲结构衬得很小，以反差建立尺度。整体效果繁密、偏冷而安静地富于戏剧性，纪律严明的线描承担空间复杂度。
theme_en: An older man with a cane walking among sweeping blue-green structural curves
theme_zh: 一位拄手杖的年长男子行走在蓝绿结构曲线之间
name: Francois Schuiten
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
